The source calls Dokja an ordinary office worker and describes a fictional online novel becoming real. It does not establish a diagnosis, disability, age, class position beyond that occupational descriptor, or real-world trauma equivalence.
No real-world religious, ethnic, national, or cultural equivalence is assigned to fictional mechanics or characters.
